content.value: Calculate the function of atom sites that are vacant for copper (Cu) at its melting temperature (10) of 1084°C. Assume an energy for vacancy formation of 0.90 eV/atom. The atomic weight and density for copper are 63.5 g/mol and 8.4 g/cm³ respectively at 1084 °C.
